resources.string: This edition has no internet or location permissions, Google Play Services dependency or navigation foreground service. Maps, search and available routing use local included or installed data. Interests, explicit visits, pins and route history are stored on this device; app cloud backup and device-to-device transfer are disabled. Sharing a location is an explicit action that opens another app; that app has its own privacy policy. There are no analytics, ads or accounts.
This offline edition does not use GPS. You can view a route, but turn-by-turn navigation requires the standard edition with location permission.
Routing data is not available. This offline edition includes an Adelaide demo map but no routing pack or live GPS guidance.
